old_definition_issues.detail: the joint numerator counts 9 GT-reference-unavailable positives where the model correctly emitted no keypoint; these are joint-ok but are NOT localization successes and do not enter the anchor/bearing error denominator

joint uses 238 GT-observable positives with a complete bbox+reference label; localization accuracy can only use the 218 positives whose GT reference point is available. The rates are not interchangeable.
identity precision uses the 218 identity claims as denominator; identity recall uses the 238 positives. Both are reported; precision must not be quoted as detection recall.

reference coverage denominator is 218 positives with an available GT reference point; it includes presence misses (9) and confidence-suppressed keypoints (28), which are retained as failures rather than dropped.

the correct-subset anchor/bearing statistics are conditional on success (62 of 181 emitted keypoints). The all-emitted error distribution and the wrong-anchor distribution are reported separately; the correct-subset median is not an unconditional accuracy.
the GT reference point is derived from the strict-green component; the model keypoint is trained on the same cue. Agreement is same-source reproducibility, not independent physical accuracy.
this pool has 0 annotation-side GT_UNOBSERVABLE frames; the exclusion rule is implemented and tested but was not exercised by the exploratory data. That is INCOMPLETE coverage, not a pass.
all saved predictions are DETECTED or NOT_DETECTED; the UNKNOWN/REJECTED retention rule is implemented and tested but not exercised by this pool.
no frame carries a verified similar-structure confuser (HN1); identity precision is conditional on a pool without a verified identity-negative, so it cannot certify identity.

definitions.presence: TP if DETECTED with bbox IoU >= tau_iou (or any DETECTED on an absent frame is FP); NOT_DETECTED/UNKNOWN/REJECTED on a positive is FN.
definitions.identity: precision = correct claims / claims; recall = correct claims / positives; negative false-match rate = high-confidence claims on absent frames / negatives.
definitions.reference_availability: available GT reference (VISIBLE) vs unavailable GT reference (keypoint null). coverage = correct keypoints / available; false-reference rate = keypoints emitted on unavailable / unavailable.
definitions.localization_accuracy: emitted keypoint within tau_px of the GT reference point, among available-reference positives only; presence misses and confidence-suppressed keypoints stay in the denominator.
definitions.joint: denominator = GT-observable positives with bbox+reference label; LOCALIZED = joint-ok via available reference; CORRECT_REFUSAL = joint-ok via correctly declaring an unavailable reference (never a localization success); composite_rate = (localized + correct_refusal) / joint denominator, NOT a localization rate.

green_anchor_audit.limit: same-source check: the label keypoint is derived from the same strict-green rule as the model cue target; agreement is reproducibility, not independent physical accuracy
